subject: google/zerocopy Exocrate remote archive checksum semantics at 41f5b37afe7060fd9fe08c00b200672cd76d77b9

configured_digest.representation_in_Cargo_toml: exactly 64 hexadecimal digits; lowercase and uppercase accepted
configured_digest.runtime_representation: [u8; 32] baked into RemoteArchive at compile time
configured_digest.selection: compile-time OS/ARCH match among the pairs named in parse_remote_archive!

hashed_bytes.domain: all response-body bytes exposed by the Source::Remote reader through EOF, before zstd decompression
includes: the zstd-compressed archive bytes consumed while tar extraction runs
compressed/body bytes read ahead by the decoder
trailing response-body bytes not required for decompression, because Exocrate drains the underlying hashing reader after dropping the decoder
hashed_bytes.does_not_mean: raw HTTP wire framing such as transport/chunk framing; the hash is over bytes exposed by the HTTP body reader

verification_order: open remote response and obtain body reader plus expected digest
stream body through HashingReader -> zstd decoder -> tar unpack into staging
drain the underlying HashingReader to EOF so trailing bytes contribute
finalize SHA-256 and compare with expected digest
only a successful population can proceed to final staging publication

important_limits.pre_authentication_effects: checksum acceptance occurs after extraction effects in staging; see the separate extraction-security/#3612 report
important_limits.existing_installations: an already-existing managed target is accepted by existence and is not rehashed/revalidated against the configured remote digest
important_limits.local_source: Source::Local supplies no expected digest; local trust/checksum semantics are a separate #3720 subject
important_limits.digest_provenance: SHA-256 comparison authenticates bytes only relative to trust in the compiled expected digest; Exocrate does not itself establish how that digest was produced or signed
important_limits.anneal_v2_current_metadata: current main still contains placeholder URLs and hashes marked FIXME before publication

namespace_coupling.effect: changing the remote checksum/URL in Anneal Cargo.toml also changes Exocrate's version_slug/installation directory, barring a SHA-256 collision
